projects.title: HeartFlow OS
projects.description: AST transpiler compiling trained Scikit-Learn ensembles into zero-malloc C99 headers (<512B stack, 8.15KB SRAM) for microcontrollers, with a 60 FPS Web Serial dashboard.
deepDive: Wrote an AST transpiler that compiles Scikit-Learn soft-voting ensembles into zero-malloc C99 headers (<512B stack) for ESP32-S3, Cortex-M4, and RP2040 microcontrollers.
Implemented INT8 quantization to cut SRAM usage by 76.4% (34.6KB to 8.15KB) and achieve 18.4 µs on-device inference (54,340 vec/sec) vs. a 35ms cloud baseline.
Streamed 250 Hz ECG/PPG packets over Web Serial (115,200 baud) to a 60 FPS Next.js canvas with 120 µs in-browser inference, verified across 58 PyTest bounds tests in Docker.

projects.title: HF Pluggable Gateway
projects.description: Aggregation API gateway and container runtime dynamically mounting isolated Python subpackages into a single container with build-time weight prefetching.
deepDive: Architected an extensible pluggable service gateway that dynamically mounts isolated subproject packages under dedicated route prefixes (/heartflow, /semantic) via standard entrypoint registry mappings.

Baked model weights into container image layers via build-time prefetching scripts (prefetch.py) and executed startup memory warmups in background worker threads, driving first-request cold-start latency down below 100ms.

Implemented robust edge security controls including SecurityHeadersMiddleware (CSP frame-ancestors, HSTS, nosniff), unbuffered chunk stream byte metering, early Content-Length 413 rejections, and a live web developer console.

projects.title: Semantic Comment Analyzer
projects.description: High-throughput local NLP classifier delivering sub-15ms intent and entity recognition with word-level occlusion explainability inside <4GB RAM.
deepDive: Used all-MiniLM embeddings with Logistic Regression and SVM heads, achieving <15ms CPU latency and 1,000+ req/sec batch throughput across custom intent labels.
Combined a RoBERTa sentiment pipeline, 3-class NER, and word-level occlusion explainability into a single endpoint returning 7 structured decision fields.
Packaged with a vectorized Pandas CSV batch handler engineered to run locally within a strict <4GB RAM memory ceiling with zero cloud dependency.

projects.title: Vera AI Engine
projects.description: Deterministic multi-tier AI orchestrator featuring a 4-tier fail-fast fallback cascade and hardware-level grammar enforcement.
deepDive: Engineered a deterministic 4-tier fallback cascade (NVIDIA NIM Nemotron-3 550B → Groq GPT OSS 20B → Gemini 2.5 Flash → Local CPU Llama.cpp Qwen2.5) with strict timeout budgets to guarantee responses in <30s on 2vCPU Hugging Face Spaces.

Implemented the Python Caveman distillation pattern, compressing 500KB+ JSON raw merchant and trigger payloads into structured factual bullet points in <0.001s, eliminating context bottlenecks and preventing metric hallucinations.

Enforced hardware-level LlamaGrammar constraints at the logits level for local SLM execution, guaranteeing 100% valid JSON schema compliance, paired with an intra-tier auto-repair loop for taboo and word-count policies.

experience.company: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI / Aadhaar)
shortPoints: Built an offline OCR and hybrid search pipeline (FAISS + BM25 with cross-encoder reranking) for 12 Indian languages. Kept memory under 16GB RAM on CPU machines by running quantized models sequentially, and added a verification tool for human review.
Wrote an async ETL pipeline that loads 50MB workbooks (100k+ rows) into SQLite WAL in 5 to 15s, indexing 4.2M+ telemetry records with row-level access control for over 1,000 users.

projects.title: Offline OCR & Hybrid RAG Document System
points: Engineered a 3-phase pipeline: PDF disk-write → OpenCV preprocessing (Otsu threshold, deskew, CLAHE contrast) + Tesseract OCR → Ollama boundary detection → strict JSON extraction at temp=0.0 with malformed outputs dumped to flat files for manual review.
Used Ollama (gemma3:4b) to detect salutations and closings, splitting multi-page PDF bundles into distinct logical documents.
Built a degradation-aware fallback that monitors extracted character counts per page, routing low-confidence or degraded handwritten scans to manual review before downstream LLM extraction.

Developed a custom HTML/JS triage dashboard with per-document analysis views, displaying extracted metadata, model summaries, and the original scan side-by-side with confidence scores and urgency filters.

Kept peak system memory strictly under 16GB RAM on CPU-only air-gapped machines by running quantized models sequentially, streaming uploads directly to disk, and splitting multi-letter bundles at 1 to 2 min/letter on degraded scans.

projects.title: High-Throughput Telemetry ETL & Analytics Backend
points: Built dual ingestion paths combining manual UI uploads with an automated APScheduler cron that sweeps configured directories every 3 minutes for unindexed files, enforcing idempotency via composite unique constraints and ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE logic.

Processed 50MB workbooks through stateless domain parsers using vectorized NumPy calculations, prefix-based source routing, and 1,000-row batch upserts, using WebSocket streaming to prevent UI blocking during heavy ingestion.

Consolidated 4 disparate telemetry streams (telephony logs, IVR events, call records, and agent summaries) into a single relational schema with dynamic time-bucketing (daily/weekly/monthly) and bidirectional cross-filtering across 4.2M+ records.

Built agent performance quadrants plotting CPH × AHT × Occupancy and hourly volume heatmaps to surface intraday bottlenecks masked by daily averages, with client-side caching to prevent DB contention.

Enforced tenant isolation by injecting JWT claims into SQLAlchemy base queries, bcrypt password rehashing, X-Forwarded-For client IP capture for non-repudiation audit trails, and automated 90-day log pruning.
